verdict.rationale: Anrok publishes an extensive documented public REST API (apidocs.anrok.com) with endpoints for customers, transactions, certificates, filings, products, address resolution, tax IDs, ephemeral tax previews, rate limiting, and auth via API keys, plus curl examples and an openapi.yaml spec, and explicitly markets 'Run tax through Anrok's APIs' for agentic use. Missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of API robustness/usage beyond vendor docs, and the probes show llms.txt/openapi.json endpoints returning 404 at expected canonical locations, suggesting some machine-readability gaps.
